visual_brief.subject: A compact multimodal model narrows varied inputs into bounded choices and probabilities
verified_context: Kakao released public weights and a model card for a small multimodal model that accepts text and optional images.
The model returns probabilities for bounded choices, yes or no questions and ordered scores rather than generating prose.
Kakao's speed and benchmark comparisons remain vendor-reported in this edition.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A narrow decision interface turns varied context into inspectable bounded outputs instead of open-ended prose.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Mixed paper and translucent image fragments enter a compact stone decision instrument and emerge as a few differently weighted terracotta channels.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. The compact central instrument visibly narrows mixed paper and translucent inputs into a small set of weighted terracotta outputs without resembling an interface.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. The physical balance is expressive, but it emphasizes load balancing more than bounded model decisions.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The optical aperture communicates multimodal compression, though it reads as feature extraction more than choice probabilities.

crop_review.article_desktop: The mixed inputs, central instrument and three output bands remain readable across the wide hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered crop retains the complete instrument and the widest input and output paths.
crop_review.thumbnail: The pale central block and terracotta output fan remain distinct at 320px.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate matches the model references' pale sculptural mass, restrained terracotta paths, fine construction lines and large negative-space fields. Its central artifact is more machine-like than the references, so fit is scored at 85.
